description: Antenne di Telefonia Mobile del Comune di Trapani Dataset is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provincia.trapani.sitr.it. Mobile Phone antennas in the Municipality of Trapani updated on 31/12/2012. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile Phone antennas of the Municipality of Trapani Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
